title: Asset Redemption Cancellation Success
description: This event occurs when the redemption cancellation is processed successfully.

asset_id.title: Asset ID
asset_id.description: Unique asset identifier defined by client. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Cetip code of registrator of asset. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform. It needs to be in every API call. An organization can have multiple issuer IDs.

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: External identifier for operation. field provided by customer in asset redemption operation.

unit_value.title: Asset unit value received from API
unit_value.description: Unit value redeemed received from API
